query: WITH desired AS (SELECT id, provider_id, alias_name, regexp_replace(lower(trim(alias_name)), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') AS desired_normalized FROM public.provider_name_aliases WHERE source = 'workbook_import'), alias_overlap AS (SELECT d.id, d.provider_id, d.alias_name, d.desired_normalized, array_agg(DISTINCT a.provider_id) FILTER (WHERE a.id IS NOT NULL) AS existing_provider_ids FROM desired d LEFT JOIN public.provider_name_aliases a ON a.source <> 'workbook_import' AND regexp_replace(lower(trim(a.alias_name)), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = d.desired_normalized GROUP BY d.id, d.provider_id, d.alias_name, d.desired_normalized) SELECT count(*) AS workbook_aliases, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(array_length(existing_provider_ids, 1), 0) > 0) AS overlapping_aliases, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(array_length(existing_provider_ids, 1), 0) > 0 AND NOT (provider_id = ANY(existing_provider_ids))) AS cross_provider_overlaps FROM alias_overlap LIMIT 1
